description: This file defines a class 'PunchOutMenuConfigurator' that implements a menu configuration interface for the OrangeHRM Attendance module. It overrides the module and screen context to 'time' and 'punchIn' respectively, likely to customize menu behavior in the HRM system.

classes.name: PunchOutMenuConfigurator
classes.description: Implements the MenuConfigurator interface to configure menu settings for the punch-out functionality in the attendance module. Overrides module to 'time' and screen to 'punchIn'.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Configures the menu by overriding the current module to 'time' and screen to 'punchIn'.
